title: Funds deposited at a gambling site and withdrawn elsewhere
summary: The funds go to a gambling site in 1 to 3 deposits and move on the site's own ledger for 1 to 5 days. They then come out to a different wallet.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 50 cases in 100.

parties.label: the wallet that holds the funds
a different wallet that receives the withdrawal

steps.say: The funds go to the gambling site in a few deposits.

basis.note: The report describes deposits to a gambling site. It gives no figures. The count of 1 to 3 deposits, the waits and the uneven split are assumed.

steps.say: After 1 to 5 days on the site's own ledger the funds are withdrawn to a different wallet.

basis.note: The report describes withdrawal to a different wallet with little trail on the chain between deposit and withdrawal. The bets and moves on the ledger are not modelled as legs, and the wait of 1 to 5 days is assumed.
